resources.string: Start a night, Turbo, Boost, Cool, Warm and Off. Shows more buttons when you make it bigger.
One button: a profile, Turbo, Boost, Cool, Warm or Off.
Finish the phone checks above, then choose the BedJet you want this phone to control. Keep the other phone’s BedJet app closed during the check.
With the BedJet idle and someone beside it, run the brief fan check. Nocturne returns the fan to its previous setting.
Supervised fan check completed for this BedJet 3. You can repeat it while the BedJet is idle.
Your answer is saved with this completed night. Any profile change is shown for you to accept separately.
This affects future nights only. The completed night and any running programme keep their recorded settings.
This night can no longer be checked in. Refresh History and try again.
This suggestion is out of date. Review the profile before changing it.
Choose a spare slot. Slot %1$d is reserved for tonight and cannot be replaced.
Choose a BedJet in Settings before writing a slot.
The BedJet, slot setting or profile changed. Close this preview and open it again.
This programme preview is out of date. Close it and open it again before writing a slot.
End the current night before writing another slot.
This profile cannot be kept on a slot now.
The BedJet stores these durations as a fixed programme. It does not follow later alarm or profile changes. The existing slot is saved first so you can restore it from Settings.
No reading while the BedJet is out of reach
Step lengths must be between 1 minute and 12 hours.
Long heat cannot honour this profile\'s temperature limits
Your BedJet won\'t run a phase this long. Shorten the Heat phases or use Long heat.
Profiles changed. Review your selection and try again.
Use your night palette and day palette at these times. Equal times keep your night palette all day.
